headline: Approved a conditional police officer job offer to candidate #10 and removed five other candidates from hiring lists.
summary: The meeting went into executive session to interview police officer candidates, and no votes were taken there. In public session, the commission removed five candidates from hiring lists and offered conditional employment to candidate #10.
decisions: Removed candidate ranked #3 from the certified list dated August 21, 2026; approved unanimously.
Removed candidates #4, #7, #12, and #20 from the entry level list dated May 29, 2026; approved unanimously.
Offered conditional employment to candidate #10 from the entry level list dated May 29, 2026; approved 3-1.

plain_text:
BOARD OF POLICE COMMISSIONERS 
SPECIAL MEETING 
                                                      SEPTEMBER 8, 2026, AT 5:00 p.m. 
 
 
PRESENT:             ABSENT:  
Commissioner Paul Lemieux      Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Chairperson   
Commissioner Rory Ghio       Commissioner Terry Lewis          
Commissioner Gloria Sapp-Smith    Commissioner Dean Kilbourne 
Council Member Sue Tyler               
 
 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Commissioner Lemieux called the meeting to order at 5:23 P.M. 
 
 
2. TO CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW CANDIDATES FOR THE 
POSITION OF POLICE OFFICER AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS NECESSARY. 
Commissioner Ghio moved to CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW 
CANDIDATES FOR THE POSITION OF POLICE OFFICER, seconded by Council Member Tyler.       
 
Present in Executive Session: Commissioners Lemieux, Sapp-Smith, Ghio, Council Member Tyler, 
Chief Morello, and Deputy Chief Osborne. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
No votes taken in Executive Session. 
 
 
3. TO RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS 
NECESSARY.  
At 6:03 p.m., Council Member Tyler moved to RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION, seconded by 
Commissioner Sapp-Smith. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
 
Commissioner Ghio moved to REMOVE CANDIDATE RANKED #3 FROM THE CERTIFIED LIST 
DATED AUGUST 21, 2026, seconded by Council Member Tyler. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
Commissioner Ghio moved to REMOVE CANDIDATES #4, #7, #12, AND #20 FROM THE ENTRY 
LEVEL LIST DATED MAY 29, 2026, seconded by Council Member Tyler. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED
Commissioner Ghio moved to OFFER CONDITIONAL EMPLOYMENT TO CANDIDATES #10 
FROM THE ENTRY LEVEL LIST DATED MAY 29, 2026, seconded by Council Member Tyler. 
 
Commissioner Lemieux -  yes 
Commissioner Ghio  - yes 
Commissioner Sapp-Smith -  yes 
Council Member Tyler - no 
 
 
               VOTE: PASSED 
 
4. ADJOURNMENT 
Commissioner Ghio moved to ADJOURN, seconded by Council Member Tyler. 
 
The regular meeting of the Board of Police Commissioners called for the 8th day of September, 2026, 
was HEREBY ADJOURNED AT 6:05 p.m. 
 
 
                   Lisa Ziogas                   Recording Secretary
